headline: Reliance Jio IPO Subscribed 3.16 Times on Opening Day with Bids Worth Rs 95,500 Crore
summary: Reliance Jio's initial public offering was subscribed 3.16 times on its first day, drawing bids worth Rs 95,500 crore led by institutional buyers.
why: Large initial public offerings provide liquidity to capital markets and indicate institutional appetite for telecommunications and digital infrastructure plays.

impacts.name: Reliance Jio
impacts.why: Strong initial public offering demand provides substantial capital and indicates robust institutional appetite.
